ms.report:
Refusal 1 Updates:
What was updated per request of the milestone reviewers:
The 8 slides now meet the 20-25 slide acceptance criteria.
Website updated with tabs to each event
Refusal 2 Updates
The Twitter posts are no longer available as it was a paid promotion with Coinbound.io through their monthly retainer model. Once the month expires and you do not continue to use their services, they return your login credentials but keep any content (the posts + pictures) they generated. I attached my email convo with Anthony Leon from coinbound.io for reference as well as a screenshot from the contract specifying this. We were able to achieve 5.5K, 4.3K, 4.8k, and 5.1k for the posts. I know the 4.3k and 4.8k are below the 5k promised but we were limited by payment delays reducing our time to deliver from mid August- October 20th to September 1st- October 20th (2 weeks less time than originally expected). I hope you can understand our situation.
Link to contract + email with coinbound.io team to showcase we no longer have access to posts as it was their intellectual property provided via month retainer model for their marketing services: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1irgYnGIr0nXXKSTfdpt4EwAvXVUFnyuNKrIhNloMhH4/edit?usp=sharing
